svg.title: 00 Sign in

g.text: Requisitions, quotations, evaluation, LPOs, delivery and payment: one record
per purchase, approved by the right people, open to auditors.
International Development Institute Uganda · Plot 45 Wilson Avenue, Jinja

svg.text: One sign-in for IDIU staff and registered suppliers.
In the order the work flows · each sees only their menus
set up → request → approve → buy → receive → audit

g.text: Demo environment with illustrative data: nothing here touches IDIU's live records.
